extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down the running man step into small muscle memory chunks with clear verbal instructions. She demonstrates from various angles and provides supportive tips and common mistake corrections.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction and overview of the running man tutorial
Breaking down the running man into four components
Step 1: The perch forward back motion
Step 2: Two footed flat foot split

common_mistakes: landing like a jog instead of both feet landing at the same time
leaning too far forward or too far back
safety: take support like a wall or chair if you need confidence for the hop back

steps_taught.name: The Perch Forward Back
steps_taught.description: Standing on one foot with the other knee in a tabletop position, bringing the foot down in front and back to center

steps_taught.name: Two Footed Flat Foot Split
steps_taught.description: Hopping to split the center line with both feet landing flat footed at the same time

steps_taught.name: Weighted Foot Hop Back
steps_taught.description: Standing on one foot and hopping backward without putting the raised foot down on the center line

what_works: breaking the move into small distinct chunks
using props like a chair for balance support
explaining common mistakes and body posture

quotes.text: kind of like a tabletop position here
pretend you're kind of on a center line here
it's because you don't have the ankle strength
